notes.title: The Aliens Have Landed – New Update Out Now!
notes.content:
Update Alert: They Came From Another Planet 🚀🌍

A brand new update has just landed for They Came From Another Planet, and it's packed with exciting new features and improvements!

🎮 Competitive Fun with Leaderboards:
You can now see how your scores stack up against players from around the world! Climb the global leaderboards and challenge your friends to beat your high score.

🏆 Achievements Galore:
A whole new set of achievements has been added for you to unlock. Whether you're a completionist or just love a good challenge, there’s plenty to discover.

🕹️ Improved Controller Support:
Controller support has been enhanced for a smoother gameplay experience. Prefer the keyboard? You can now use the I, J, K, and L keys as an alternative to the arrow keys (though we still recommend using a controller for the best experience).

🐞 Minor Bug Fixes:
This update also includes a handful of smaller bug fixes and performance improvements to keep things running smoothly.

Ready to jump back in? The aliens aren’t going to defeat themselves…
